answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a ferrous mass-token whose orbital rendezvous history is attested through proof-of-proximity burns, making forged agents pay real propellant. Each pearl of verified thrust telemetry becomes a relic of unique maneuver provenance, so duplicate identities cannot replay another craft's burn schedule without. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
